A few questions

So the mockups start from the right assumptions.

What is this, shaped like?*

This decides the pipeline — a headless project never gets a Studio stage. Changeable later in Knowledge.

A UI app — people will look at it and click it
Headless — an API, CLI, library or service
Mixed — it has a face and a programmable surface
What visual style should the mockups aim for?*

You said you want to see how it looks first, so this drives everything.

Clean & minimal
Playful & colorful
Dark & sleek
Native mobile feel (iOS/Android-like)
Should the calculator split the bill between people?*

Splitting adds a people-count control to the main screen.

No — just tip and total
What belongs on the settings screen?*

Pick everything you want; unchecked items stay out entirely.

Default tip percentage

Currency

Light/dark theme toggle
How should currency work?*
USD only
